webview.title: Agents
webview.col.tokens.tip: Tokens in the latest model call (input + cache + output), the same number Claude Code shows
webview.col.time.tip: How long the agent has been running (or ran)
webview.ctx.label: Context
webview.zone.consider.tip: At a task milestone: compact if you're continuing the same task, or start a new session for a new one.
webview.zone.act.tip: Handle it at the next milestone. Don't wait for auto-compact to kick in in the middle of a task.
webview.zone.basis: These zones are inferred from data on earlier models and Anthropic's own practice; there's no public long-context data for the newest models.
webview.zone.newTask: Switching to an unrelated task? A new session works better than compacting.
webview.compacted.tip: Counts both automatic and manual compactions in this session's transcript.
webview.compactMany: Compacted several times already. If there's still a lot to do, have the model write a handoff note and start a new session.
webview.compactMany.basis: “Several” means 2 or more, a rule of thumb.
webview.compactLoop: May be stuck in a compaction loop
webview.compactLoop.tip: Compacted twice within 10 minutes, or context was still high right after compacting.
webview.cache.tip: Prompt cache for the main conversation. Compacting before it expires costs much less than after.
webview.compact.tip: Compact this session's context. You choose how (and, for a closed Claude session, which model) before anything runs.
webview.autoCompact.tip: Choose when Claude Code compacts this session on its own. You'll see presets with their trade-offs; nothing changes until you pick one.
webview.sessionCost.cc.tip: Claude Code's own running total for this session, in API-equivalent dollars.
webview.sessionCost.estimate: Agent Monitor's estimate at list prices: {usd}
webview.store.label: Transcript
webview.store.tip: Where this conversation is saved on your computer. The prompt cache itself is kept on the provider's servers, not here. To move these files to another disk, run “Agent Monitor: Storage Locations and Usage”.
webview.result.truncated: Truncated. Open the transcript for the full text.
webview.transcriptMissing: The transcript file can't be found. The session may have been moved or deleted.
webview.tip.processed: Processed so far: {n} tokens (input + output of every call, cache reads included)
webview.tip.click: Click to show recent steps, result, changed files and errors.
